title: ApplyCrossFade - ImageSpaceModifier
content:
Member of: ImageSpaceModifier Script Applies this image-space modifier to the cross-fade modifier chain, fading between the last one on the chain and this one over the specified duration. Syntax: Function ApplyCrossFade(float afFadeDuration = 1.0) native Parameters: - afFadeDuration: How long the crossfade should take, in seconds. Default: 1.0 Return Value: None. Examples: ; Cross-fade to the blood effect over 1 second BloodSplatter.ApplyCrossFade()
; Cross-fade to the blood effect over half a second BloodSplatter.ApplyCrossFade(0.5) See Also: - ImageSpaceModifier Script - RemoveCrossFade - ImageSpaceModifier
